description: This file defines classes for managing AWS IoT device shadows, including actions and shadow management functions such as publish, subscribe, and unsubscribe, utilizing MQTT core handler.

classes.name: _shadowAction
classes.description: Represents a shadow action with associated MQTT topics for get, update, delete, and delta operations.

classes.name: shadowManager
classes.description: Manages shadow operations such as publish, subscribe, and unsubscribe using an MQTT core handler.

methods.name: _shadowAction.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a shadow action with shadow name and action type, setting appropriate MQTT topics.

methods.name: _shadowAction.getTopicGeneral
methods.description: Returns the general topic for the shadow action.

methods.name: _shadowAction.getTopicAccept
methods.description: Returns the accepted topic for the shadow action.

methods.name: _shadowAction.getTopicReject
methods.description: Returns the rejected topic for the shadow action.

methods.name: _shadowAction.getTopicDelta
methods.description: Returns the delta topic for the shadow action.

methods.name: shadowManager.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the shadow manager with an MQTT core handler.

methods.name: shadowManager.basicShadowPublish
methods.description: Publishes a payload to the shadow's general topic.

methods.name: shadowManager.basicShadowSubscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to shadow topics (delta or accepted/rejected) with a callback.

methods.name: shadowManager.basicShadowUnsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from shadow topics (delta or accepted/rejected).
